substeps.label: 2/6 Colour check
substeps.caption: Lift clear. The camera checks the strip's colour: NFPA 484 11.4.1 allows no metal dust that "obscures the color of the surface beneath it". Clear.

substeps.label: 3/6 A visible spill
substeps.caption: Its camera finds a visible layer in the aisle by the sieving cell (a dropped cup; ours, an illustration). That is a person's job (vacuum SOP 8): unit 3 stops its vacuum, keeps 1 m away and messages the person and EHS.

substeps.label: 4/6 The person
substeps.caption: The person comes with a natural-bristle push broom and a conductive lobby dustpan. SOP 8 also has them restrict access, ventilate and call EHS (not drawn).

substeps.label: 5/6 The bulk
substeps.caption: The bulk first, by hand: NFPA 484 11.5.1, "conductive, nonsparking scoops and soft brooms as well as brushes that have natural fiber bristles". The robot never sweeps a visible spill.

substeps.label: 6/6 The residue
substeps.caption: The pan tipped back and lifted: into a conductive bag, sealed, to the grounded pail (SOP 4.4), and logged. The residue is unit 3's: it parks there, bonds, squeegees and checks the colour (11.5.2: vacuums "only for residual amounts").
